text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a final sanity pass for the 0.23.1 cut. Primary asks: version bump, changelog note, QA smoke checklist, and security signoff. Can folks confirm ownership for each?

aj: I can own the version bump + branch pin. Will do the tag after QA signoff. ETA ~30m.

sam: I can take changelog edits — will verify PRs are listed and add the short breaking-note for the batching change.

jess: QA smoke owner here. I'll run the smoke suite against rc/staging and report regressions. Ping me when cut is staged.

maria: Thanks. Two quick blockers: 1) a flaky test in integration-matrix (we should either skip or fix pre-cut), 2) a pending Snyk alert that security-bot flagged.

aj: For the flaky test, can we cherry-pick the fix in #4123? If yes I can include it in the cut branch.

sam: I reviewed #4123 — small change, safe. Go ahead with cherry-pick. Add a changelog line referencing the fix.

jess: deploy-bot, can you stage rc/0.23.1 to canary now? I'll start smoke on canary.

deploy-bot: Canary staging triggered by @jess. Build: 0.23.1-rc+2026-03-17. Instances spinning up in us-west1 and eu-west1.

security-bot: Snyk: High severity dependency lodash@4.17.21 — remediation PR #4189 submitted. Please ensure security signoff before cut.

maria: Good catch. aj — can you and security team confirm whether PR #4189 should be merged into rc branch or we handle as a post-cut hotfix?

aj: Quick check — PR fixes a dev-time dependency in one package, low runtime exposure. My recommendation: merge into rc to avoid churn. I'll queue the merge and run a quick build.

sam: Changelog draft done, added two bullets and a note about metric name change. Putting it in #changelogs for final look.

jess: Canary smoke started. Initial results: auth path and basic generate endpoints OK; one flaky failure on long-sequence streaming test. Investigating. (reacted :hourglass_flowing_sand:)

maria: If streaming fails consistently, fallback plan: cut without the streaming optimization and patch in a follow-up. But let's wait for jess's run.

jess: Update — streaming failure repros locally when run with --batch-depth=4. Pushing a quick test-only skip to the canary job to see if rest of suite passes.

aj: Merge of #4189 is queued, will land in ~10m. Also cherry-picked #4123 and pushed to rc/0.23.1-cherry. Build triggered.

security-bot: Scan after merge: no new issues detected. Security signoff: provisional. Please add post-cut monitoring alert for dependency regressions.

sam: Changelog approved by @maria. Added authors and links.

jess: Smoke now passing green except the streaming flaky test which I skipped — everything else looks good. Logs: ```
PASS auth smoke
PASS embeddings basic
PASS generation latency under 200ms
FAIL streaming-seq (skipped for canary)
```

maria: OK — team decision: proceed with cut once aj confirms the build is green and deploy-bot reports canary health stable for 15m. Add a prominent changelog note about the streaming opt being rolled back and a TODO to re-enable after fix.

aj: Build is green. Tagging 0.23.1-rc. Pushing tag now.

deploy-bot: Tag 0.23.1-rc created. Rolling canary -> 15m health monitoring started.

jess: 15m monitoring passed, latency and error rates stable.

maria: Security signoff confirmed by security-bot. QA signoff from jess. Changelog and version bump done by sam/aj. I'm going to escalate to release-cut channel for final cut window. Thanks team :tada:

aj: If anything slips, my rollback plan is ready: revert cherry-pick and redeploy previous tag. I'll be on standby.

sam: Leaving a post-cut checklist in #release-ops: docs checklist, sample prompts, and release-note publishing tasks.

maria: Perfect. Final last-minute asks: someone add the release note to the release tracker, and disable the flaky streaming test in CI with a TODO referencing #4190.

jess: I'll add the CI skip and note.

maria: Great — thread resolved for 0.23.1 cut. Will follow up in release-cut with timestamps. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
